result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major contrast problem in the promo banner where white text sits on a very light mint background making it nearly unreadable, and two minor layout/cosmetic issues.

issues.description: The promo banner '3 free deliveries for you' uses white text on a very light mint green background, resulting in extremely low contrast; the text and 'Order now' label are barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (e.g., dark green or charcoal) for the heading and body text on the light mint background, or darken the banner background so white text passes WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card touches the top-right edge of the image with no margin, unlike other cards, and appears to bleed to the card boundary.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent padding (e.g., 12-16px) around overlay icons on all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The food card images in 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' appear as blurry placeholder illustrations rather than real photos of the dishes.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder/blurred images with actual food photography once available, or keep stylized illustrations but ensure they render sharply.
